api.function: navigationUtility(element: HTMLElement, label: string): NavigationUtility | undefined
api.position: Document-position control: exact rel home token, explicit breadcrumb navigation semantics/structure, or complete skip-operation name pointing to a unique local structural content/navigation target.
api.branch: Existing pure no-op anchor with a direct meaningful nested semantic menu/list, or explicit local disclosure targeting a semantic menu/list. Suppresses broad reading inference only; does not itself reject explicit own help/apply/document meaning.
api.undefined: No confirmed utility evidence, or protected/ambiguous input, form, editor, ordinary destination, leaf JS, readonly-panel or FAQ case.

contractBaseline.note: No navigation-utility component existed before this work. The initial undefined-return contract stub exposes unsupported positive requirements. These are not an old-product classifier regression score, independent evaluation or quality baseline; root owns integrated old-engine behavior comparison.

scopeFinding.note: New synthetic counterexample reproduced unscoped comma-selector alternatives admitting a deeper unrelated ol/heading. Corrected selectors with :is wrappers.

coverage: Unknown-named semantic breadcrumb trail and exact breadcrumb class + real list structure
Class/rel lookalikes and ordinary guide navigation stay eligible
Strong skip names with main/nav or structurally identified generic wrapper; unique explicit fragment target
Actual noop parent with sibling submenu versus an ordinary HTTP document parent, leaf JS or empty content list
Explicit local aria-expanded/controls semantic menu/list and role menu structures
FAQ answer wrappers, citation lists and readonly tab panels do not become branch
Default/external form ownership, editors, hidden sources and private value/checked/editor getter canaries
Deep unrelated list/heading cannot substitute for a direct relation

currentnessIntegration.required: Root should serialize navigationUtility(element,safeLabel) ?? null into sourceSnapshot attributes. The module has no analyzer imports, so this introduces no analyzer dependency cycle.
currentnessIntegration.reason: An accepted source can later acquire a breadcrumb ancestor semantic marker, rel home, skip-target meaning or real submenu relationship while its own name/action remain equal. The enum comparison rejects that previous source classification at same-frame activation. No title/panel positive evidence for accepted leaves is introduced.
currentnessIntegration.unusedAttribute: itemtype is not read; no itemtype watcher needed.

implementationBoundary.cache: No retained DOM or metadata cache; every call reads current local fixed attributes/structure.
implementationBoundary.labels: Uses only the caller-provided already-safe fixed source label and fixed aria-label metadata identifying breadcrumb navigation. Does not read other controls' names or source body prose.
implementationBoundary.queryStates: No source host/path or opaque query values identify utilities. Fragment IDs are explicit relationships, not hardcoded values.
implementationBoundary.structuralBounds: Target ID <=128 chars; breadcrumb traversal <=4 ancestors and <=12 direct items; menu/list <=24 direct items; generic skip-content heading depth <=2. Structural descendant selectors detect protected form/editor boundaries; they do not read values or text.
limits: Only explicit #fragment spellings are treated as skip/disclosure target relationships; ordinary links preserve their destination.
Pure noop JS grammar is conservative; arbitrary JS is not assumed to be a menu without explicit local disclosure metadata.
Nested list source reclassification is semantic only; shared dangerous URL/script guards and activation policy remain root responsibilities.
